<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterInfo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CancelDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Subscription System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TriggerBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ActiveMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TermsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TermsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Deactivate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SignUp" name="Customer signs up for subscription"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterInfo" name="Enter personal and payment information"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account and assign access"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_TriggerBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycles"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ActiveMerge" name="Subscription active"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send updates, product enhancements or renewal notifications"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CancelDecision" name="Customer cancels?"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitCancel" name="Submit cancellation request"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancel" name="Process cancellation request"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsSplit" name="Refund or charge per terms"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Deactivate" name="Deactivate subscription"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignUpToEnter" sourceRef="StartEvent_SignUp" targetRef="Task_EnterInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterToAccount" sourceRef="Task_EnterInfo" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountToBilling" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingToActive" sourceRef="Task_TriggerBilling" targetRef="Gateway_ActiveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActiveToUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveMerge" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesToCancelDecision" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_CancelDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoCancelToActive" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ActiveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YesCancelToSubmit" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelDecision" targetRef="Task_SubmitCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToProcess" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancel" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessToTerms" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancel" targetRef="Gateway_TermsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsToRefund" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsToCharge" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsSplit" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundToTermsMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChargeToTermsMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_TermsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsMergeToDeactivate" sourceRef="Gateway_TermsMerge" targetRef="Task_Deactivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeactivateToSettle" sourceRef="Task_Deactivate" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SettleToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
